description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component, specifically testing request validation and evaluation logic in various security and decision scenarios within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluatorTests
classes.description: A structure encapsulating multiple test cases for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component.

methods.name: validate request rejects empty command
methods.description: Tests that a request with an empty command array is rejected as invalid.

methods.name: evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision
methods.description: Tests that evaluate correctly requires a prompt when allowlist is not satisfied and no decision is made.

methods.name: evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss
methods.description: Tests that a allow once decision is correctly allowed when allowlist is not satisfied.

methods.name: evaluate denies on explicit deny decision
methods.description: Tests that an explicit deny decision results in denial regardless of other conditions.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Helper method to create a context used in multiple tests, configured with specific security and ask settings.
